verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk-operation capability, such as acting on many projects, records, or items in one operation. The MCP tool `execute_sql`, which handles writes and migrations, is only a raw developer primitive from which a user could build bulk changes, so it earns no credit. The axis is a fair question for an AI app-building platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
